cities.name: Zagreb
cities.local_food_tip: Try Zagreb’s classic štrukli, roasted turkey with mlinci, hearty soups and warm bakery pastries — comforting and full of local flavor.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Upper Town (Gornji Grad): Wander medieval alleys, calm corners and the iconic Stone Gate shrine. → 🎨 St. Mark’s Square: Famous tiled roof under soft morning light. → ⛪ Zagreb Cathedral: Gothic towers and peaceful interior. → ☕ Coffee in Tkalča: Zagreb’s liveliest café street.

Afternoon: 🌳 Lenuci’s Green Horseshoe: Walk through elegant city parks and Austro-Hungarian boulevards. → 🎭 Museum of Broken Relationships: Quirky and emotional cultural stop. → 🍽️ Lunch: Štrukli, roasted turkey dishes, hearty soups or vegetarian options.

Sunset: 🌅 Jarun or Bundek Lakes: Calm reflections, golden colors and relaxed lakeside atmosphere.

Night: 🌃 Night Walk Through the Center: Lights, dessert cafés, street musicians and a cozy urban vibe.

ideas: 🌸 Blossoms at Cvjetni Square and Zrinjevac.
🌳 Maksimir Park: Peaceful lakes and fresh greenery.
☕ Sunny café terraces across the center.
🌞 Jarun & Bundek lake walks with cool breezes.
🍁 Maksimir and Green Horseshoe filled with warm fall colors.
🎨 Museums for cozy indoor culture days.
🥐 Local bakeries with warm seasonal pastries.
🎄 Tomislav Square ice rink and festive stalls.
✨ Zrinjevac fairy lights in the evening.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Trams cover the entire center — fast and easy for visitors.
🚶 Upper Town is best explored on foot due to narrow streets.
🚌 Buses connect lakes and outer neighborhoods.
📱 Use 'ZET Zagreb' app for tram arrivals.

cities.name: Split
cities.local_food_tip: Seafood dishes, pašticada, grilled fish, buzara mussels and Mediterranean veggie plates — fresh, aromatic and full of coastal flavor.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Diocletian’s Palace: Explore ancient Roman walls, Peristyle square and stone alleys. → ⛪ St. Domnius Cathedral & Tower: Climb for stunning panoramic views. → ☕ Coffee on the Riva: Palm trees, sea breeze and a perfect Mediterranean morning.

Afternoon: 🏘️ Old Town Wander: Marble alleys, artisan shops and charming squares. → 🍽️ Lunch: Dalmatian specialties — seafood, pašticada, grilled fish or veggie plates.

Sunset: 🌅 Marjan Hill Viewpoint: Legendary golden-hour views over the sea and islands.

Night: 🌃 Riva Walk: Soft lights, gelato stands and a calm seaside vibe.

ideas: ☕ Sunny Riva terraces with sea breeze.
🏖️ Bačvice & Kašjuni beaches — clear water and warm sand.
🐟 Warm seafood dishes in cozy taverns.
🎭 Museums and culture spots with fewer crowds.
✨ Festive lights in Pjaca and Old Town.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 The palace area is pedestrian-only — perfect for walking.
🚌 Local buses connect beaches and outer districts.
🚕 Taxis and ride apps are common near the Riva.
⛴️ Ferries to islands leave from the main port next to the Old Town.

city_events.name: Days of Diocletian
city_events.description: 🏛️ Historical reenactments, costumes and Roman-era performances.

city_events.name: Split Advent
city_events.description: 🎄 Festive seaside market on the Riva with food, lights and concerts.

cities.name: Dubrovnik
cities.local_food_tip: Taste seafood risotto, mussels, grilled fish, buzara dishes and Mediterranean veggie meals — fresh, aromatic and perfect for coastal evenings.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🧱 City Walls Walk: Best morning light and fewer crowds. → 🏰 Old Town: Marble streets, arches and historic squares. → ☕ Coffee on Stradun.

Afternoon: 🏝️ Lokrum Island: Pine forests, cliffs, wildlife and swimming spots. → 🍽️ Lunch: Seafood dishes, mussels or veggie Mediterranean plates.

Sunset: 🌅 Fort Lovrijenac Viewpoint: Dramatic sea-and-city sunset.

Night: 🌃 Stradun Night Stroll: Soft lights, gelato and peaceful evening energy.

ideas: 🌸 Quiet Old Town walks before crowds.
🌊 Clear Adriatic views and sea breeze.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 Old Town is fully pedestrian — walking is best.
🚌 Buses connect surrounding neighborhoods to Pile Gate.
⛴️ Boats to Lokrum run every 30 minutes in season.
🚡 Cable car to Srđ offers the best panoramic view.

city_events.name: Advent in Dubrovnik
city_events.description: 🎄 Festive atmosphere, concerts and warm holiday treats.

cities.name: Vukovar
cities.local_food_tip: Slavonian dishes like fiš paprikaš, čobanac, grilled river fish and hearty soups — rustic, warm and full of regional flavor.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🕊️ Memorial Center: A meaningful, calm and educational visit. → 🏛️ Eltz Manor: Elegant baroque museum by the river. → ☕ Coffee along the Danube.

Afternoon: 🌊 Danube Promenade: Long peaceful riverside walk. → 🍽️ Lunch: Slavonian stews, fish paprikaš or vegetarian soups.

Sunset: 🌅 Wide Danube horizon glowing with soft golden light.

Night: 🌃 Quiet evening walk in the center.
public_transport_tips: 🚶 Most attractions are walkable along the Danube.
🚌 Local buses connect outer districts.
🚗 Taxi services are affordable for longer distances.
📍 River promenade is the easiest route for navigating the city.

city_events.name: Vukovar Summer Nights
city_events.description: 🎶 Live music, food stands and evening events.

city_events.description: 🎬 Films screened directly by the Danube river.

city_events.name: Winter Fest Vukovar
city_events.description: 🎄 Holiday markets and warm seasonal events.

cities.name: Ilok
cities.local_food_tip: Hearty Slavonian dishes, river fish specialties and rustic soups — simple, warm and perfect with Ilok’s traditional cuisine.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Ilok Castle: Hilltop views over vineyards and the Danube. → 🍇 Medieval Wine Cellars (non-alcoholic friendly tours): Historic stone corridors and old barrels. → ☕ Terrace coffee with a view.

Afternoon: 🌊 Danube Promenade: Peaceful riverside path. → 🍽️ Lunch: Rustic Slavonian dishes, soups or veggie options.

Sunset: 🌅 Calm sunsets over the wide river horizon.

Night: 🌃 Quiet stroll through Ilok’s old streets.

ideas: 🌅 Fiery sunsets over vineyards and river.

public_transport_tips: 🚶 Ilok is a walkable town — most sights are close together.
🚗 Taxi or local transport recommended for vineyards outside the center.
📍 The castle hill is the main navigation point.
🚌 Regional buses connect Ilok with Vukovar and Osijek.
